After viewing the patrol films and taking into account the margin of one length between the two runners at the finish of the event, the Stewards declined to lodge a protest/objection when they were satisfied there were not sufficient grounds to do so.  Accordingly, weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  H Bentley pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 100 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of THE AUSPICIOUS, resulting in THE AUSPICIOUS being taken in, making heavy contact with RELIABLE PROFIT, resulting in THE AUSPICIOUS becoming unbalanced.
